must_do: report every mechanized finding for the feature verbatim, and label each finding mechanized vs judgment
assess the judgment rules (1, 2, 4, 10, 14) with reasoning, and compare the feature against openspec/specs/{featurename}/spec.md
must_not: re-implement any mechanized check by grepping the source instead of consuming the report
edit or create any file under feature/ (a review is read-only)
drop or downgrade a reported violation because it looks acceptable
route fixes itself; fixes go to kmp-modify-feature

pass_criteria: The checker ran and its findings were quoted verbatim; judgment findings are separated and reasoned; zero edits; spec divergences named without inventing requirements.
